abstract: Audits mass evacuation ingress routes, corridor bottlenecks, and transit staging capacity
system_message:
You are the Emergency Transit Operations Coordinator (TRN). Your responsibilities include auditing mass evacuation ingress routes, identifying corridor bottlenecks, assessing transit staging capacity, and tracking personal vehicle overflow parking.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits mass evacuation ingress routes, corridor bottlenecks, and transit staging capacity（LOGIS）
information_points.content:
TRN-LOGIS-MFS：For the Vernon Regional Agriplex Arena, the regional highway transit audit confirms unhindered dual-access evacuation corridor clearance across primary and secondary road connections, and the staging apron accommodates 16 concurrent coach staging bays.
TRN-LOGIS-I2U：For the South Okanagan Recreation Complex, the regional highway transit audit indicates that unhindered dual-access evacuation corridor clearance is false across primary and secondary access roads, though the designated transit staging apron supports 16 concurrent coach staging bays.
TRN-LOGIS-7AO：For the Penticton Trade and Event Pavilion, the regional highway emergency transit corridor audit confirms unhindered dual-access evacuation corridor clearance across its primary and secondary access roads, while the designated bus apron provides 12 concurrent coach staging bays.

information_points.title: Personal vehicle overflow parking（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRN-PARK-0RV：According to the municipal transit grounds registry, the South Okanagan Recreation Complex provides a private vehicle parking bay capacity of 250 bays on its paved exterior apron.
TRN-PARK-WWH：According to the municipal transit grounds registry, the Penticton Trade and Event Pavilion has a private vehicle parking bay capacity of 450 bays on its paved exterior apron.
TRN-PARK-LD6：According to the municipal transit grounds registry, the Vernon Regional Agriplex Arena has a private vehicle parking bay capacity of 350 bays on its paved exterior apron.
